topic: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing. (a) GSE maintenance. Schedule & record of inspections carried out (b) Calibration of GSE (as applicable) and record of calibration.
specific_objectives: 29.1.1.9 Trainee will be able explain various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of GSEs on dispersal, verification of maintenance schedules, and inspection of calibration records.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Ground Support Equipment (GSE)?
Why is regular maintenance of GSE critical for flight safety?
Can you name one GSE used for aircraft refueling?

topics: GSE required for dispersal flying activity
GSE required for flight servicing operations
GSE maintenance schedules and inspection records

GSE required for dispersal flying activity

topics: Role of trainees in GSE upkeep
development.content:

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a maintenance schedule and a calibration record.
What steps should be taken if a GSE calibration certificate is expired?
How does proper GSE maintenance impact overall flight safety?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the GSE items observed during the dispersal area walk, noting their current maintenance status and any calibration due dates, to be submitted in LP 10.
